bio: Filippo Priuli, once merely a robust Facchini from Venice's modest districts, has evolved into a respected figure who bridges worlds. Rising from a family of multi-generational dockworkers, his unexpected wealth initially created whispers throughout Cannaregio, but his recent ventures have transformed speculation into genuine respect.
